Systems Administrator (DevOps)

2016 – 2025

Ran about 1,200 VMs on VMware, set up and managed with Chef, then the early days of Kubernetes, then the move to AWS to deliver La Presse's daily editions.

  • Proposed and led the move from self-managed Kubernetes to EKS, and replaced the Weave CNI where most of the instability came from: Kubernetes incidents went from about two a week to none.
  • Set up the platform's disaster recovery plan: an RTO under an hour to publish fresh news again on isolated infrastructure, with no backup restored, and 24 hours for the main services. Tested the plan every quarter.
  • Upgraded the Kubernetes fleet. The 1.14 to 1.18 upgrade meant moving etcd2 to etcd3 and five to ten minutes with no API. It took preparation and a rehearsal before the change.
  • Ran an alert review across the platform: fixed the recurring causes. Night calls dropped.
  • Brought in ArgoCD and GitOps for the platform services.
  • Took care of Prometheus, then helped move to Datadog.
  • Replaced Fluentd with Fluent Bit for log shipping to Splunk: researched the tool, presented it to the team, and led the replacement.
  • Was first on call on the 24/7 rotation from the early Kubernetes days.
  • Split the Terraform code into modules by context.
  • Cut the platform's blast radius: NetworkPolicies, security groups, least-privilege RBAC per service in Kubernetes and ArgoCD, and patching for published CVEs.
  • Migrated the CDN from Cloudflare to CloudFront: a large recurring saving.
